title: MicroFlasher - Protected Binary Web Serial Flashing Platform
shortDescription: A zero-install, browser-based hardware flashing utility utilizing the Web Serial API for secure firmware uploads and binary protections across microcontrollers without requiring native toolchain configurations.

detailSections.title: Overview
detailSections.content: MicroFlasher eliminates the friction of flashing microcontroller firmware by leveraging modern Chromium Web Serial API capabilities directly in the browser. Users can connect ESP32, ESP8266, and Arduino targets, upload compiled binaries, inspect serial bootloader logs, and configure Wi-Fi credentials with zero CLI installations or python package dependencies.

detailSections.title: Web Serial Protocol & Binary Packet Pipeline
detailSections.content:
MicroFlasher implements the low-level SLIP (Serial Line Internet Protocol) and ESP bootloader synchronization state machines directly in TypeScript:

• Baud Rate Auto-Negotiation: Automatically establishes initial sync at 115200 baud, then negotiates high-speed transfers up to 921600 baud for ultra-fast flashing.
• Flash Partition Validation: Validates partition offsets (Bootloader, Partition Table, Application binary) before initiation to prevent memory corruption.
• Protected Binary Delivery: Decrypts authenticated client firmware chunks in-memory using Web Crypto API to protect proprietary IP before burning to flash.
